in_arabic.name: عمرو
in_arabic.meaning: عمر وافر و طويل، العمر المديد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: العمر الطويل، العمر وافر، وقد ورد ذكر اسم عمرو في القرآن الكريم في سورة العمر، الآية ٧٢ من سورة الحجر، و هو أحد الأسماء التي تطلق على عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه، ثاني الخلفاء الراشدين

in_urdu.name: عمر

in_hindi.name: उमर
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमर एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है लंबा जीवन या समृद्ध जीवन, यह नाम उमर इब्न अल-खत्ताब के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो इस्लाम के दूसरे खलीफा थे, और उनकी खलीफा की अवधि 634-644 ईस्वी तक चली

in_english.name: Umaru
in_english.meaning: Long life, prosperous life, well-lived age
in_english.long_meaning: Umaru originates from Arabic 'umr', meaning 'life' or 'age'. It signifies a long, prosperous life. Umar, a variant, was notably borne by Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second Caliph of Islam. The name connotes a wish for a well-lived, lengthy life, embodying values of longevity and vitality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Umaru has significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it is the name of one of the greatest leaders in the history of Islam: Umar ibn Al-Khattab. He was the second Caliph of the Rashidun Caliphate, reigning from 634 to 644 CE, considered one of the Rightly-Guided Caliphs who ruled according to the prophetic model. His leadership was characterized by justice, military expansion, and sound administration, expanding the Islamic empire significantly during his rule.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Umaru signifies a deep sense of long-term growth, prosperity, and a meaningful name for a future generations. It is said that in the Islamic tradition, every person has a spiritual mission and their name holds spiritual significance. The spiritual meaning of the name Umaru can be interpreted as a reminder to remember the importance of living a long and prosperous life, filled with spiritual growth, self-improvement and dedication towards serving Allah and humanity. It is also a reminder to focus on the long-term journey towards reaching inner and outer peace, happiness and fulfillment, a journey that lasts a lifetime. Additionally, it is a reminder to continue striving for excellence in one’s character, reflecting the values represented by the name Umar ibn Al-Khattab, as a role model of leadership, justice, and wisdom.
